text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is finally time for Narita Top Road's 
debut race. As she feels on the verge of 
being crushed by the pressure, her 
classmates appear before her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if responding to the words of 
encouragement from everyone, Narita Top 
Road psychs herself up once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I――will definitely live up to everyone's 
expectations!" Narita Top Road's debut 
race begins now!
